Top candidates: Goss's Wilt (water-soaked tan lesions with freckles on stalk/leaves) or Bacterial Stalk Rot (yellowing/rotting at stalk nodes).

Let me view a reference for Goss's Wilt.

The Goss's Wilt reference shows leaf-level wilting/streaking, which doesn't match the test image. The test image shows stalk node damage — yellow-amber water-soaked lesions with dark brown necrosis at a node/leaf sheath junction. This pattern (water-soaked rot at nodes, yellowing, mushy appearance) is characteristic of Bacterial Stalk Rot.
